meta.name: hunt-k8s
meta.description: Hunt Kubernetes & Docker — API anonymous access, kubelet 10250 exec (SPDY/WebSocket, NOT plain POST) and the simpler /run primitive, etcd 2379 unauth, dashboard skip-login, RBAC misconfig, secret/SA-token abuse, docker.sock host escape, runc/container-escape (Leaky Vessels CVE-2024-21626), API-server-mediated nodes/proxy RCE, EphemeralContainers node-shell, bound/projected SA-token audience+expiry abuse, admission-controller bypass, Helm/Tiller remnants. Use when target runs containerized infra, exposes K8s ports (6443/10250/10255/2379/8443), or cloud metadata reveals K8s service accounts.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用K8s与Docker的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对容器化基础设施进行安全评估和渗透测试。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit security vulnerabilities in K8s and Docker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to perform security assessments and penetration tests on containerized infrastructure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检查 Kubernetes 和 Docker 的安全漏洞，比如 API 匿名访问、kubelet 远程命令执行、etcd 未授权访问、容器逃逸等，并给出具体的测试命令。
howto.when: 当目标运行容器化基础设施，暴露了 Kubernetes 端口（如 6443、10250、2379 等），或云元数据暴露了 K8s 服务账户时触发。

say.text: 检查目标 10.0.0.1 的 Kubernetes API 是否允许匿名访问。
测试 kubelet 10250 端口的 /run 接口能否执行命令。
say.note: Claude 会发送 curl 请求并返回命令输出。

say.text: 检查 etcd 2379 端口是否未授权访问。
say.note: Claude 会尝试读取 etcd 中的密钥数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you hunt security misconfigurations in Kubernetes and Docker, such as anonymous API access, kubelet remote command execution, unauthenticated etcd access, container escape, etc., and provides specific test commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target runs containerized infrastructure, exposes Kubernetes ports (e.g., 6443, 10250, 2379), or cloud metadata reveals K8s service accounts.

say_en.text: Check if the Kubernetes API on target 10.0.0.1 allows anonymous access.
Test if the kubelet /run endpoint on port 10250 can execute commands.
say_en.note: Claude will send a curl request and return the command output.

say_en.text: Check if etcd on port 2379 is unauthenticated.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to read secret data from etcd.
